title: Ramayana: Part 1 grosses ₹100 crore+ worldwide on each of its first 7 days (5–11 Nov; Bollywood Hungama, Variety India); week one ₹934.55 cr (Sacnilk)
headline: Ramayana Grossed ₹100 Crore+ Worldwide Every Day for 7 Days
caption:
Ramayana: Part 1 grossed more than ₹100 crore worldwide on every one of its first seven days in cinemas, from Thursday 5 November to Wednesday 11 November, according to trade figures reported by Bollywood Hungama and Variety India. Bollywood Hungama calls it the first Bollywood film to do that.

By Bollywood Hungama's daily figures, its best day was Monday 9 November, the day after Diwali, at ₹158.38 crore, and its closest call was day 7, Wednesday, at ₹100.10 crore. Trackers' daily numbers differ.

Sacnilk puts the first-week worldwide gross at ₹934.55 crore: ₹611.05 crore gross from India (₹511.10 crore net) and ₹323.50 crore from overseas. Sacnilk and Koimoi say that already takes it past Animal's lifetime worldwide gross, making it Ranbir Kapoor's highest-grossing film. Gross is ticket money before cinemas and distributors take their share, not profit.

Have you watched Ramayana in a cinema yet, and in which language?

Full story on idly.news (link in bio).

Sources: Bollywood Hungama, Variety India, Sacnilk, Koimoi
